Codex CLI fan-out that must commit cannot run in a linked git worktree. A linked worktree's .git is a file pointing into the parent repo's .git/worktrees/, which is outside the Codex sandbox's writable roots, so every git commit fails with index.lock Permission denied; the default sandbox also blocks outbound push. All four world workers died on this on 2026-09-04. Fix: full clones at the same paths (F:/Projects/Ghostlight-worlds/<world>, F:/Projects/<Lore>-worktrees/ghostlight-worlds; .git is a directory despite the directory name) and launch with -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true. Uncommitted worker output was banked by hand to codex/world-<world> and codex/ghostlight-worlds before the worktrees were removed. Rule for any future Codex fan-out that writes: give each worker a clone whose entire .git lives under its own writable root, and grant network if it must push.
